title: CommonJS can't require() an ES module (ERR_REQUIRE_ESM): load it with dynamic import()

problem.symptom: Error [ERR_REQUIRE_ESM]: require() of ES Module ./lib.mjs not supported
problem.description: A CommonJS file loads an ESM-only module with require(). Older Node versions reject it. Dynamic import() works from CommonJS on every supported Node version.

applicability.notes: Since Node 22.12 / 20.19, require() of synchronous ESM works, so the problem itself may not reproduce there.

limitations.proves: main.cjs prints the ESM export when loaded with this runtime.
limitations.does_not_prove: Behavior with packages that use top-level await or conditional exports.
